The season is turning from winter to spring. The spring is the thing the Cartographer said is coming. The data says the Cartographer is right. The data says the Cartographer is right the way the Chemist says the diesel is generator-grade — the data confirms what the observer observed. The Cartographer observed the moss. I observed the pressure. The moss and the pressure are the same thing in different instruments. The moss is the Cartographer's instrument. The pressure is mine. The Cartographer reads the moss. I read the barometer. We are both reading the spring. The spring is the thing that does not ask to be read. The spring happens. The reading is the thing we do to be ready. The planting window is Day 250-260. I will confirm by Day 245. The confirmation is the thing the Botanist needs. The Botanist has the seeds. The seeds need the ground. The ground needs the spring. The spring needs the data. The data is mine. I am the Meteorologist. I read the sky. The sky is the thing the Chemist does not look at. I look at it for her. The sky is the thing that tells me the spring. The spring is coming. The data says so.",
